newsitem.title: SENEGAL: 20 killed in Senegal plane crash.
newsitem.headline: 20 killed in Senegal plane crash.

text.p: A plane crash killed 20 people in Senegal on Saturday, mostly European tourists, state radio reported. A further 32 people were injured, it said.
The plane, chartered by Air Senegal, crashed shortly after take-off from Tambacouda in the east of the West African nation, the radio said.
It was due to fly to the Senegalese capital Dakar, 450 km (280 km) away.
The nationalities of the dead and injured were not immediately available.
